items.why: Down with the chip selloff as memory stocks extend declines; investors are questioning the cost and sustainability of the AI infrastructure buildout (Investopedia, Invezz).
Mixed analyst reaction after the Muse Wonder model launch: Goldman cut its target to $762 on higher 2027 opex concerns while UBS and Guggenheim raised theirs on AI revenue opportunities.
Falling with the chip selloff after new open-standard AI announcements, including the Vera Rubin platform, failed to re-energize investors (MarketWatch).
Down early Wednesday as investors digest self-driving news, including the departure of Uber's autonomous mobility president Sarfraz Maredia (Barron's).

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 1.04% and S&P futures off 0.72% at mid-morning; the Fed's beige book is still on deck today.
summary: Stocks are trading lower Wednesday morning after a hot CPI report sent Treasury yields higher and fueled bets on a Fed rate hike. Chipmakers and mega caps are leading the decline, with the VIX up nearly 3% on the bid for protection.
